thread:
Marta: quick question — I pushed a draft dashboard for GPU node rotation metrics, can folks skim? https://grafana.internal/r/xyz789 :wave:
Sam: looking now, link works :+1:
Marta: main idea: proactively rotate nodes that show sustained Xid/ECC spikes instead of waiting for hard OOMs. want to align alerts with a health_score and SLOs by region.
Lee: sounds sensible. what's the health_score formula?
Marta: rough proposal below. want feedback on weights and caps.
Marta: ```
# GPU health_score (0-100)
# health_score = 100 - (5*normalized_xid_rate) - (3*normalized_corrected_ecc) - (2*normalized_flaky_card_incidents) - temp_penalty
# normalized_* are scaled 0-10 based on historical p95 per-region
```
Sam: scaling 0-10 is fine but cap each component at 25 to avoid one metric blowing up the score. also add a `drain_recent` modifier for nodes that were drained in the last 48h so we don't double-count.
Vikas: cost question — rotating aggressively costs utilization. need a back-of-envelope: expected GPU-hours lost vs probability of catastrophic failure. any quick numbers?
Marta: rough stat: each rotation costs ~1.5 GPU-hours (cordon+evict+reboot). if rotation prevents a 24h outage once per 500 nodes, it's net positive. but needs per-region usage numbers.
Olivia: SLOs: do we want region-level SLOs (e.g., us-west1 GPU-health >= 99.5) or a single global SLO with regional alerts?
Lee: per-region SLOs please. failures correlate regionally (power, rack). easier to route to the owning infra team.
Sam: PromQL for 24h sustained Xid rate panel:
Sam: ```promql
sum by (node) (increase(nvidia_gpu_xid_errors_total[24h]))
/ sum by (node) (increase(nvidia_gpu_duty_seconds_total[24h]))
```
Sam: convert to per-hour and normalize to the region p95 for the normalized_xid_rate input.
Marta: adding a recording rule to smooth spikes:
Marta: ```yaml
groups:
- name: gpu_health.rules
  rules:
  - record: node:gpu_xid_rate:24h
    expr: |
      (sum by(node) (increase(nvidia_gpu_xid_errors_total[24h]))
       / max(1, sum by(node) (increase(nvidia_gpu_duty_seconds_total[24h]))))
```
Lee: alerting thresholds suggestion: node:gpu_xid_rate:24h > 0.0005 for 6h => yellow (throttled); >0.002 for 1h => red immediate oncall. map those back to health_score buckets.
Olivia: mapping request: green >=90, yellow 70-89, red <70? that sound right for ops dashboards.
Marta: yes — we'll wire those health_score buckets to dashboard colors and alert severity.
Vikas: let's add a `flaky_card` metadata tag in node labels when we detect transient resets, so automation skips nodes under manual triage.
Sam: good — we can use label `gpu_maintenance=manual` and automation will honor it.
ops-bot: incident created #INC-3421 (auto) — node gpu-node-42 exceeded xid threshold in us-west1 :rotating_light:
Marta: tagging @oncall-us-west1 — should we auto-evict pods and rotate, or require SRE approval?
Lee: prefer auto-evict + mark for replacement after 2nd occurrence in 30d. first occurrence => cordon + drain but keep node available for low-priority jobs.
Olivia: update runbook to show `rotation_actions` column (auto/manual/pending) and a cost estimate per rotation. need to surface that in the dashboard.
Marta: added an experimental panel to the dash that shows `expected_gpu_hours_lost` and `estimated_risk_reduction` using a simple model (see panel). would appreciate eyeballs.
Sam: one more: tag traffic by model profile (prod vs dev) so rotations can deprioritize dev-only nodes during burst windows.
Marta: noted — will add `traffic_profile` as a dimension in recording rules and panels.
Vikas: who owns final SLO numbers? product infra or platform reliability? implications for SLA docs.
Olivia: platform reliability owns SLA definitions. product infra owns per-region tuning and alerts. legal should be looped for external SLA language.
Marta: action items:
- Lee: prototype alert rules mapping health_score -> yellow/red + auto-evict policy (ETA 48h)
- Sam: add recording rules and refine panels (ETA 24h)
- Vikas: compute rotation cost model per-region (ETA 72h)
- Olivia: update SLO doc with per-region proposal and check SLA wording with legal (ETA end of week)
Marta: leaving the dashboard in Draft for now. ping this thread when you push changes. :seedling:
Sam: will open a PR for the recording rules and link it here.
Lee: drafting runbook updates and will post to #eng-oncall for review.
Olivia: will sync with legal on SLA implications this afternoon.
Marta: thanks all — closing the loop, will tag if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
